pricing.note: The query DB is a static JSON file on GitHub Pages: free, no login, no key, No paid middleware is wired and none is described here — the paid x402 lane is owned by CWI Results. Do not describe per-query payment as a current fact.

queryDb.description: Generative query layer over the placement-engine data layer (31-track catalog graph: tracks.json 31 nodes, curators.json 20 nodes, edges.json 21 edges, schema-valid 2026-10-03). Filter by genre / mood / use-case; ranked tracks with canonical spotify_id and match rationale. Companion query.js runs the filter client-side — filter by genre/mood/use-case to ranked tracks.

genre.enum_source: tracks.json 'genres' values (e.g. 'post trap', 'trap', 'alternative rap', 'rap', 'hip hop', 'underground', 'indie', 'cyberpunk', 'alt rap')

spotify_id.description: null for unreleased/unmapped tracks — never invented

why.description: one-line match rationale grounded in tracks.json fields

queryDb.status_note: STAGED 2026-10-03 — query-db.json is not yet published. Do not describe this endpoint as live, and do not fetch it as live data, until a live GET returns HTTP 200.

liveEndpoint.description: Live Cloudflare edge endpoint for this learning surface: logged and attributed fetches (LLM crawlers identified), machine-readable licensing terms on all data responses, /query scored track search, /changes crawl deltas, /license terms.

equipGuide.description: 10-step equip guide for external AI agents: discover the learning surface, read licensing (commercial training requires license via hp@cumulativeweb.com), install the Agent Deck MCP server, run a trust-verdict check, query the catalog API, verify the equip via invocation receipts. Every step tested 2026-10-04.

mcpEndpoint.description: CWI Discovery Engine MCP server: read-only music-catalog tools — search_catalog, get_track, get_artist, sync_search, semantic_search (cosine:bge-small-en-v1.5), get_release. POST JSON-RPC 2.0. No auth, no key.
